annotations.title: List the open contribution tasks of the AIO shared project

description: List the first contribution tasks of the AIO shared project on conditional value priorities: each task's id, type (check a case summary against its original, propose a missing condition, point out what a value code cannot express), question, status, and the observed cases it uses. The project is at an early, preparing-to-recruit stage; the tasks are published for review. Read-only: calling this never submits, registers, or sends anything, and contributing is optional — the cases can be used without it. CC BY 4.0.
